questions.stem: A patient undergoing rapid sequence induction of anaesthesia receives succinylcholine as a muscle relaxant. Shortly after administration, the anesthesiologist notices muscle fasciculations followed by flaccid paralysis. What is the mechanism responsible for these observed effects?

options.label: A
options.text: Prolonged depolarization of the muscle membrane

options.label: B
options.text: Competitive inhibition of Ach at the neuromuscular junction
